verses.lat: 83:12 Quia misericórdiam, et veritátem díligit Deus: * grátiam et glóriam dabit Dóminus.
verses.eng: 83:12 For God loveth mercy and truth: * the Lord will give grace and glory.

verses.lat: 83:13 Non privábit bonis eos, qui ámbulant in innocéntia: * Dómine virtútum, beátus homo, qui sperat in te.
verses.eng: 83:13 He will not deprive of good things them that walk in innocence: * O Lord of hosts, blessed is the man that trusteth in thee.

verses.lat: 86:1 Fundaménta ejus in móntibus sanctis: * díligit Dóminus portas Sion super ómnia tabernácula Jacob.
verses.eng: 86:1 The foundations thereof are in the holy mountains: * The Lord loveth the gates of Sion above all the tabernacles of Jacob.

verses.lat: 86:3 Gloriósa dicta sunt de te, * cívitas Dei.
verses.eng: 86:3 Glorious things are said of thee, * O city of God.

verses.lat: 86:4 Memor ero Rahab, et Babylónis * sciéntium me.
verses.eng: 86:4 I will be mindful of Rahab and of Babylon * knowing me.

verses.lat: 86:4 Ecce, alienígenæ, et Tyrus, et pópulus Æthíopum, * hi fuérunt illic.
verses.eng: 86:4 Behold the foreigners, and Tyre, and the people of the Ethiopians, * these were there.

verses.lat: 86:5 Numquid Sion dicet: Homo, et homo natus est in ea: * et ipse fundávit eam Altíssimus?
verses.eng: 86:5 Shall not Sion say: This man and that man is born in her? * and the Highest himself hath founded her.

verses.lat: 86:6 Dóminus narrábit in scriptúris populórum, et príncipum: * horum, qui fuérunt in ea.
verses.eng: 86:6 The Lord shall tell in his writings of peoples and of princes, * of them that have been in her.

verses.lat: 86:7 Sicut lætántium ómnium * habitátio est in te.
verses.eng: 86:7 The dwelling in thee * is as it were of all rejoicing.

ant_nona.label: Antíphona
ant_nona.lat: Misericórdia et véritas * præcédent fáciem tuam, Dómine.
ant_nona.eng: Mercy and truth * shall go before thy face, O Lord.

verses.lat: 88:2 Misericórdias Dómini * in ætérnum cantábo.
verses.eng: 88:2 The mercies of the Lord * I will sing for ever.

verses.lat: 88:2 In generatiónem et generatiónem * annuntiábo veritátem tuam in ore meo.
verses.eng: 88:2 I will shew forth thy truth with my mouth * to generation and generation.

verses.lat: 88:3 Quóniam dixísti: In ætérnum misericórdia ædificábitur in cælis: * præparábitur véritas tua in eis.
verses.eng: 88:3 For thou hast said: Mercy shall be built up for ever in the heavens: * thy truth shall be prepared in them.

verses.lat: 88:4 Dispósui testaméntum eléctis meis, jurávi David, servo meo: * Usque in ætérnum præparábo semen tuum.
verses.eng: 88:4 I have made a covenant with my elect: I have sworn to David my servant: * Thy seed will I settle for ever.

verses.lat: 88:5 Et ædificábo in generatiónem et generatiónem * sedem tuam.
verses.eng: 88:5 And I will build up thy throne * unto generation and generation.

verses.lat: 88:6 Confitebúntur cæli mirabília tua, Dómine: * étenim veritátem tuam in ecclésia sanctórum.
verses.eng: 88:6 The heavens shall confess thy wonders, O Lord: * and thy truth in the church of the saints.

verses.lat: 88:7 Quóniam quis in núbibus æquábitur Dómino: * símilis erit Deo in fíliis Dei?
verses.eng: 88:7 For who in the clouds can be compared to the Lord: * or who among the sons of God shall be like to God?

verses.lat: 88:8 Deus, qui glorificátur in consílio sanctórum: * magnus et terríbilis super omnes qui in circúitu ejus sunt.
verses.eng: 88:8 God, who is glorified in the assembly of the saints: * great and terrible above all them that are about him.

verses.lat: 88:9 Dómine, Deus virtútum, quis símilis tibi? * potens es, Dómine, et véritas tua in circúitu tuo.
verses.eng: 88:9 O Lord God of hosts, who is like to thee? * thou art mighty, O Lord, and thy truth is round about thee.

verses.lat: 88:10 Tu domináris potestáti maris: * motum autem flúctuum ejus tu mítigas.
verses.eng: 88:10 Thou rulest the power of the sea: * and appeasest the motion of the waves thereof.

verses.lat: 88:11 Tu humiliásti sicut vulnerátum, supérbum: * in brácchio virtútis tuæ dispersísti inimícos tuos.
verses.eng: 88:11 Thou hast humbled the proud one, as one that is slain: * with the arm of thy strength thou hast scattered thy enemies.

verses.lat: 88:12 Tui sunt cæli, et tua est terra, orbem terræ et plenitúdinem ejus tu fundásti: * aquilónem, et mare tu creásti.
verses.eng: 88:12 Thine are the heavens, and thine is the earth: the world and the fulness thereof thou hast founded: * the north and the sea thou hast created.

verses.lat: 88:13 Thabor et Hermon in nómine tuo exsultábunt: * tuum brácchium cum poténtia.
verses.eng: 88:13 Thabor and Hermon shall rejoice in thy name: * thy arm is with might.

verses.lat: 88:14 Firmétur manus tua, et exaltétur déxtera tua: * justítia et judícium præparátio sedis tuæ.
verses.eng: 88:14 Let thy hand be strengthened, and thy right hand exalted: * justice and judgment are the preparation of thy throne.

verses.lat: 88:15 Misericórdia et véritas præcédent fáciem tuam: * beátus pópulus, qui scit jubilatiónem.
verses.eng: 88:15 Mercy and truth shall go before thy face: * blessed is the people that knoweth jubilation.

verses.lat: 88:16 Dómine, in lúmine vultus tui ambulábunt, et in nómine tuo exsultábunt tota die: * et in justítia tua exaltabúntur.
verses.eng: 88:16 They shall walk, O Lord, in the light of thy countenance: and in thy name they shall rejoice all the day, * and in thy justice they shall be exalted.

verses.lat: 88:18 Quóniam glória virtútis eórum tu es: * et in beneplácito tuo exaltábitur cornu nostrum.
verses.eng: 88:18 For thou art the glory of their strength: * and in thy good pleasure shall our horn be exalted.

verses.lat: 88:19 Quia Dómini est assúmptio nostra, * et Sancti Israël, regis nostri.
verses.eng: 88:19 For our protection is of the Lord, * and of our king the holy one of Israel.

verses.lat: 88:20 Tunc locútus es in visióne sanctis tuis, et dixísti: * Pósui adjutórium in poténte: et exaltávi eléctum de plebe mea.
verses.eng: 88:20 Then thou spokest in a vision to thy saints, and saidst: * I have laid help upon one that is mighty, and have exalted one chosen out of my people.

verses.lat: 88:21 Invéni David, servum meum: * óleo sancto meo unxi eum.
verses.eng: 88:21 I have found David my servant: * with my holy oil I have anointed him.

verses.lat: 88:22 Manus enim mea auxiliábitur ei: * et brácchium meum confortábit eum.
verses.eng: 88:22 For my hand shall help him: * and my arm shall strengthen him.

verses.lat: 88:23 Nihil profíciet inimícus in eo, * et fílius iniquitátis non appónet nocére ei.
verses.eng: 88:23 The enemy shall have no advantage over him: * nor the son of iniquity have power to hurt him.

verses.lat: 88:24 Et concídam a fácie ipsíus inimícos ejus: * et odiéntes eum in fugam convértam.
verses.eng: 88:24 And I will cut down his enemies before his face; * and them that hate him I will put to flight.

verses.lat: 88:25 Et véritas mea, et misericórdia mea cum ipso: * et in nómine meo exaltábitur cornu ejus.
verses.eng: 88:25 And my truth and my mercy shall be with him: * and in my name shall his horn be exalted.

verses.lat: 88:26 Et ponam in mari manum ejus: * et in flumínibus déxteram ejus.
verses.eng: 88:26 And I will set his hand in the sea; * and his right hand in the rivers.

verses.lat: 88:27 Ipse invocábit me: Pater meus es tu: * Deus meus, et suscéptor salútis meæ.
verses.eng: 88:27 He shall cry out to me: Thou art my father: * my God, and the support of my salvation.

verses.lat: 88:28 Et ego primogénitum ponam illum * excélsum præ régibus terræ.
verses.eng: 88:28 And I will make him my firstborn, * high above the kings of the earth.

verses.lat: 88:29 In ætérnum servábo illi misericórdiam meam: * et testaméntum meum fidéle ipsi.
verses.eng: 88:29 I will keep my mercy for him for ever: * and my covenant faithful to him.

verses.lat: 88:30 Et ponam in sǽculum sǽculi semen ejus: * et thronum ejus sicut dies cæli.
verses.eng: 88:30 And I will make his seed to endure for evermore: * and his throne as the days of heaven.

verses.lat: 88:31 Si autem derelíquerint fílii ejus legem meam: * et in judíciis meis non ambuláverint:
verses.eng: 88:31 And if his children forsake my law, * and walk not in my judgments:

verses.lat: 88:32 Si justítias meas profanáverint: * et mandáta mea non custodíerint:
verses.eng: 88:32 If they profane my justices: * and keep not my commandments:

verses.lat: 88:33 Visitábo in virga iniquitátes eórum: * et in verbéribus peccáta eórum.
verses.eng: 88:33 I will visit their iniquities with a rod: *and their sins with stripes.

verses.lat: 88:34 Misericórdiam autem meam non dispérgam ab eo: * neque nocébo in veritáte mea:
verses.eng: 88:34 But my mercy I will not take away from him: * nor will I suffer my truth to fail.

verses.lat: 88:35 Neque profanábo testaméntum meum: * et quæ procédunt de lábiis meis, non fáciam írrita.
verses.eng: 88:35 Neither will I profane my covenant: * and the words that proceed from my mouth I will not make void.

verses.lat: 88:36 Semel jurávi in sancto meo: Si David méntiar: * semen ejus in ætérnum manébit.
verses.eng: 88:36 Once have I sworn by my holiness: I will not lie unto David: * his seed shall endure for ever.

verses.lat: 88:37 Et thronus ejus sicut sol in conspéctu meo, * et sicut luna perfécta in ætérnum: et testis in cælo fidélis.
verses.eng: 88:37 And his throne as the sun before me: * and as the moon perfect for ever, and a faithful witness in heaven.

verses.lat: 88:39 Tu vero repulísti et despexísti: * distulísti Christum tuum.
verses.eng: 88:39 But thou hast rejected and despised: * thou hast been angry with thy anointed.

verses.lat: 88:40 Evertísti testaméntum servi tui: * profanásti in terra Sanctuárium ejus.
verses.eng: 88:40 Thou hast overthrown the covenant of thy servant: * thou hast profaned his sanctuary on the earth.

verses.lat: 88:41 Destruxísti omnes sepes ejus: * posuísti firmaméntum ejus formídinem.
verses.eng: 88:41 Thou hast broken down all his hedges: * thou hast made his strength fear.

verses.lat: 88:42 Diripuérunt eum omnes transeúntes viam: * factus est oppróbrium vicínis suis.
verses.eng: 88:42 All that pass by the way have robbed him: * he is become a reproach to his neighbours.

verses.lat: 88:43 Exaltásti déxteram depriméntium eum: * lætificásti omnes inimícos ejus.
verses.eng: 88:43 Thou hast set up the right hand of them that oppress him: * thou hast made all his enemies to rejoice.

verses.lat: 88:44 Avertísti adjutórium gládii ejus: * et non es auxiliátus ei in bello.
verses.eng: 88:44 Thou hast turned away the help of his sword; * and hast not assisted him in battle.

verses.lat: 88:45 Destruxísti eum ab emundatióne: * et sedem ejus in terram collisísti.
verses.eng: 88:45 Thou hast made his purification to cease: * and thou hast cast his throne down to the ground.

verses.lat: 88:46 Minorásti dies témporis ejus: * perfudísti eum confusióne.
verses.eng: 88:46 Thou hast shortened the days of his time: * thou hast covered him with confusion.

verses.lat: 88:47 Úsquequo, Dómine, avértis in finem: * exardéscet sicut ignis ira tua?
verses.eng: 88:47 How long, O Lord, turnest thou away unto the end? * shall thy anger burn like fire?

verses.lat: 88:48 Memoráre quæ mea substántia: * numquid enim vane constituísti omnes fílios hóminum?
verses.eng: 88:48 Remember what my substance is: * for hast thou made all the children of men in vain?

verses.lat: 88:49 Quis est homo, qui vivet, et non vidébit mortem: * éruet ánimam suam de manu ínferi?
verses.eng: 88:49 Who is the man that shall live, and not see death: * that shall deliver his soul from the hand of hell?

verses.lat: 88:50 Ubi sunt misericórdiæ tuæ antíquæ, Dómine, * sicut jurásti David in veritáte tua?
verses.eng: 88:50 Lord, where are thy ancient mercies, * according to what thou didst swear to David in thy truth?

verses.lat: 88:51 Memor esto, Dómine, oppróbrii servórum tuórum * quod contínui in sinu meo multárum géntium.
verses.eng: 88:51 Be mindful, O Lord, of the reproach of thy servants * which I have held in my bosom of many nations:

verses.lat: 88:52 Quod exprobravérunt inimíci tui, Dómine, * quod exprobravérunt commutatiónem Christi tui.
verses.eng: 88:52 Wherewith thy enemies have reproached, O Lord; * wherewith they have reproached the change of thy anointed.

verses.lat: 88:53 Benedíctus Dóminus in ætérnum: * fiat, fiat.
verses.eng: 88:53 Blessed be the Lord for evermore. * So be it. So be it.

completorium.antiphon.label: Antíphona
completorium.antiphon.lat: Voce mea * ad Dóminum clamávi: neque obliviscétur miseréri Deus.
completorium.antiphon.eng: I have cried * to the Lord with my voice, do not forget to show mercy, O God.

verses.lat: 76:2 Voce mea ad Dóminum clamávi: * voce mea ad Deum, et inténdit mihi.
verses.eng: 76:2 I cried to the Lord with my voice; * to God with my voice, and he gave ear to me.

verses.lat: 76:3 In die tribulatiónis meæ Deum exquisívi, mánibus meis nocte contra eum: * et non sum decéptus.
verses.eng: 76:3 In the day of my trouble I sought God, with my hands lifted up to him in the night, * and I was not deceived.

verses.lat: 76:4 Rénuit consolári ánima mea, * memor fui Dei, et delectátus sum, et exercitátus sum: et defécit spíritus meus.
verses.eng: 76:4 My soul refused to be comforted: * I remembered God, and was delighted, and was exercised, and my spirit swooned away.

verses.lat: 76:5 Anticipavérunt vigílias óculi mei: * turbátus sum, et non sum locútus.
verses.eng: 76:5 My eyes prevented the watches: * I was troubled, and I spoke not.

verses.lat: 76:6 Cogitávi dies antíquos: * et annos ætérnos in mente hábui.
verses.eng: 76:6 I thought upon the days of old: * and I had in my mind the eternal years.

verses.lat: 76:7 Et meditátus sum nocte cum corde meo, * et exercitábar, et scopébam spíritum meum.
verses.eng: 76:7 And I meditated in the night with my own heart: * and I was exercised and I swept my spirit.

verses.lat: 76:8 Numquid in ætérnum proíciet Deus: * aut non appónet ut complacítior sit adhuc?
verses.eng: 76:8 Will God then cast off for ever? * or will he never be more favourable again?

verses.lat: 76:9 Aut in finem misericórdiam suam abscíndet, * a generatióne in generatiónem?
verses.eng: 76:9 Or will he cut off his mercy for ever, * from generation to generation?

verses.lat: 76:10 Aut obliviscétur miseréri Deus? * aut continébit in ira sua misericórdias suas?
verses.eng: 76:10 Or will God forget to shew mercy? * or will he in his anger shut up his mercies?

verses.lat: 76:11 Et dixi: Nunc cœpi: * hæc mutátio déxteræ Excélsi.
verses.eng: 76:11 And I said, Now have I begun: * this is the change of the right hand of the most High.

verses.lat: 76:12 Memor fui óperum Dómini: * quia memor ero ab inítio mirabílium tuórum.
verses.eng: 76:12 I remembered the works of the Lord: * for I will be mindful of thy wonders from the beginning.

verses.lat: 76:13 Et meditábor in ómnibus opéribus tuis: * et in adinventiónibus tuis exercébor.
verses.eng: 76:13 And I will meditate on all thy works: * and will be employed in thy inventions.

verses.lat: 76:14 Deus, in sancto via tua: quis Deus magnus sicut Deus noster? * tu es Deus qui facis mirabília.
verses.eng: 76:14 Thy way, O God, is in the holy place: who is the great God like our God? * Thou art the God that dost wonders.

verses.lat: 76:15 Notam fecísti in pópulis virtútem tuam: * redemísti in brácchio tuo pópulum tuum, fílios Jacob et Joseph.
verses.eng: 76:15 Thou hast made thy power known among the nations: * with thy arm thou hast redeemed thy people, the children of Jacob and of Joseph.

verses.lat: 76:17 Vidérunt te aquæ, Deus, vidérunt te aquæ: * et timuérunt, et turbátæ sunt abýssi.
verses.eng: 76:17 The waters saw thee, O God, the waters saw thee: * and they were afraid, and the depths were troubled.

verses.lat: 76:18 Multitúdo sónitus aquárum: * vocem dedérunt nubes.
verses.eng: 76:18 Great was the noise of the waters: * the clouds sent out a sound.

verses.lat: 76:18 Étenim sagíttæ tuæ tránseunt: * vox tonítrui tui in rota.
verses.eng: 76:18 For thy arrows pass: * the voice of thy thunder in a wheel.

verses.lat: 76:19 Illuxérunt coruscatiónes tuæ orbi terræ: * commóta est, et contrémuit terra.
verses.eng: 76:19 Thy lightnings enlightened the world: * the earth shook and trembled.

verses.lat: 76:20 In mari via tua, et sémitæ tuæ in aquis multis: * et vestígia tua non cognoscéntur.
verses.eng: 76:20 Thy way is in the sea, and thy paths in many waters: * and thy footsteps shall not be known.

verses.lat: 76:21 Deduxísti sicut oves pópulum tuum, * in manu Móysi et Aaron.
verses.eng: 76:21 Thou hast conducted thy people like sheep, * by the hand of Moses and Aaron.

verses.lat: 85:1 Inclína, Dómine, aurem tuam, et exáudi me: * quóniam inops, et pauper sum ego.
verses.eng: 85:1 Incline thy ear, O Lord, and hear me: * for I am needy and poor.

verses.lat: 85:2 Custódi ánimam meam, quóniam sanctus sum: * salvum fac servum tuum, Deus meus, sperántem in te.
verses.eng: 85:2 Preserve my soul, for I am holy: * save thy servant, O my God, that trusteth in thee.

verses.lat: 85:3 Miserére mei, Dómine, quóniam ad te clamávi tota die: * lætífica ánimam servi tui, quóniam ad te, Dómine, ánimam meam levávi.
verses.eng: 85:3 Have mercy on me, O Lord, for I have cried to thee all the day. * Give joy to the soul of thy servant, for to thee, O Lord, I have lifted up my soul.

verses.lat: 85:5 Quóniam tu, Dómine, suávis, et mitis: * et multæ misericórdiæ ómnibus invocántibus te.
verses.eng: 85:5 For thou, O Lord, art sweet and mild: * and plenteous in mercy to all that call upon thee.

verses.lat: 85:6 Áuribus pércipe, Dómine, oratiónem meam: * et inténde voci deprecatiónis meæ.
verses.eng: 85:6 Give ear, O Lord, to my prayer: * and attend to the voice of my petition.

verses.lat: 85:7 In die tribulatiónis meæ clamávi ad te: * quia exaudísti me.
verses.eng: 85:7 I have called upon thee in the day of my trouble: * because thou hast heard me.

verses.lat: 85:8 Non est símilis tui in diis, Dómine: * et non est secúndum ópera tua.
verses.eng: 85:8 There is none among the gods like unto thee, O Lord: * and there is none according to thy works.

verses.lat: 85:9 Omnes gentes quascúmque fecísti, vénient, et adorábunt coram te, Dómine: * et glorificábunt nomen tuum.
verses.eng: 85:9 All the nations thou hast made shall come and adore before thee, O Lord: * and they shall glorify thy name.

verses.lat: 85:10 Quóniam magnus es tu, et fáciens mirabília: * tu es Deus solus.
verses.eng: 85:10 For thou art great and dost wonderful things: * thou art God alone.

verses.lat: 85:11 Deduc me, Dómine, in via tua, et ingrédiar in veritáte tua: * lætétur cor meum ut tímeat nomen tuum.
verses.eng: 85:11 Conduct me, O Lord, in thy way, and I will walk in thy truth: * let my heart rejoice that it may fear thy name.

verses.lat: 85:12 Confitébor tibi, Dómine, Deus meus, in toto corde meo, * et glorificábo nomen tuum in ætérnum:
verses.eng: 85:12 I will praise thee, O Lord my God, with my whole heart, * and I will glorify thy name for ever:

verses.lat: 85:13 Quia misericórdia tua magna est super me: * et eruísti ánimam meam ex inférno inferióri.
verses.eng: 85:13 For thy mercy is great towards me: * and thou hast delivered my soul out of the lower hell.

verses.lat: 85:14 Deus, iníqui insurrexérunt super me, et synagóga poténtium quæsiérunt ánimam meam: * et non proposuérunt te in conspéctu suo.
verses.eng: 85:14 O God, the wicked are risen up against me, and the assembly of the mighty have sought my soul: * and they have not set thee before their eyes.

verses.lat: 85:15 Et tu, Dómine, Deus miserátor et miséricors, * pátiens, et multæ misericórdiæ, et verax,
verses.eng: 85:15 And thou, O Lord, art a God of compassion, and merciful, * patient, and of much mercy, and true.

verses.lat: 85:16 Réspice in me, et miserére mei, * da impérium tuum púero tuo: et salvum fac fílium ancíllæ tuæ.
verses.eng: 85:16 O look upon me, and have mercy on me: * give thy command to thy servant, and save the son of thy handmaid.

verses.lat: 85:17 Fac mecum signum in bonum, ut vídeant qui odérunt me, et confundántur: * quóniam tu, Dómine, adjuvísti me, et consolátus es me.
verses.eng: 85:17 Shew me a token for good: that they who hate me may see, and be confounded, * because thou, O Lord, hast helped me and hast comforted me.

tertia.capitulum.label: Capitulum
tertia.capitulum.lat: Sana me, Dómine, et sanábor: salvum me fac, et salvus ero: quóniam laus mea tu es.
tertia.capitulum.eng: Heal me, O Lord, and I shall be healed: save me, and I shall be saved, for Thou art my praise.

responsory_breve_tertia.label: Responsory
responsory_breve_tertia.lat:
℟.br. Sana ánimam meam, * quia peccávi tibi.
℣. Ego dixi: Dómine, miserére mei.
℟. Quia peccávi tibi.
Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto.
℟. Sana ánimam meam, * quia peccávi tibi.
responsory_breve_tertia.eng:
℟.br. Heal my soul, * for I have sinned against Thee.
℣. I said: O Lord, be Thou merciful to me.
℟. For I have sinned against Thee.
Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost.
℟. Heal my soul, * for I have sinned against Thee.

capitulum_sexta.label: Capitulum
capitulum_sexta.lat: Némini quidquam debeátis, nisi ut ínvicem diligátis: qui enim díligit próximum, legem implévit.
capitulum_sexta.eng: Owe no man any thing, but to love one another. For he that loveth his neighbour, hath fulfilled the law.

responsory_breve_sexta.label: Responsory
responsory_breve_sexta.lat:
℟.br. Benedícam Dóminum * in omni témpore.
℣. Semper laus ejus in ore meo.
℟. In omni témpore.
Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto.
℟. Benedícam Dóminum * in omni témpore.
responsory_breve_sexta.eng:
℟.br. I will bless the Lord * at all times.
℣. His praise shall be always in my mouth.
℟. At all times.
Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost.
℟. I will bless the Lord * at all times.

capitulum_nona.label: Capitulum
capitulum_nona.lat: In timóre incolátus vestri témpore conversámini: sciéntes quod non corruptibílibus auro vel argénto redémpti estis, sed pretióso sánguine quasi Agni immaculáti Christi.
capitulum_nona.eng: Converse in fear during the time of your sojourning here. Knowing that you were not redeemed with corruptible things as gold or silver, but with the precious blood of Christ.

responsory_breve_nona.label: Responsory
responsory_breve_nona.lat:
℟.br. Rédime me, Dómine, * et miserére mei.
℣. Pes enim meus stetit in via recta.
℟. Et miserére mei.
Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto.
℟. Rédime me, Dómine, * et miserére mei.
responsory_breve_nona.eng:
℟.br. Redeem me, O Lord, * and have mercy on me.
℣. For my feet stood in the right way.
℟. And have mercy on me.
Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Ghost.
℟. Redeem me, O Lord, * and have mercy on me.

laudes.psalm1.label: Psalmus 98
laudes.psalm1.antiphonLat: Exaltáte * Dóminum Deum nostrum, et adoráte in monte sancto ejus.
laudes.psalm1.antiphonEng: Exalt ye the Lord * our God, and worship him upon his holy mountain.

verses.lat: 98:1 Dóminus regnávit, irascántur pópuli: * qui sedet super Chérubim, moveátur terra.
verses.eng: 98:1 The Lord hath reigned, let the people be angry: * he that sitteth on the cherubims: let the earth be moved.

verses.lat: 98:2 Dóminus in Sion magnus: * et excélsus super omnes pópulos.
verses.eng: 98:2 The Lord is great in Sion, * and high above all people.

verses.lat: 98:3 Confiteántur nómini tuo magno: quóniam terríbile, et sanctum est: * et honor regis judícium díligit.
verses.eng: 98:3 Let them give praise to thy great name: for it is terrible and holy: * and the king’s honour loveth judgment.

verses.lat: 98:4 Tu parásti directiónes: * judícium et justítiam in Jacob tu fecísti.
verses.eng: 98:4 Thou hast prepared directions: * thou hast done judgment and justice in Jacob.

verses.lat: 98:5 Exaltáte Dóminum, Deum nostrum, et adoráte scabéllum pedum ejus: * quóniam sanctum est.
verses.eng: 98:5 Exalt ye the Lord our God, and adore his footstool, * for it is holy.

verses.lat: 98:6 Móyses et Aaron in sacerdótibus ejus: * et Sámuel inter eos, qui ínvocant nomen ejus:
verses.eng: 98:6 Moses and Aaron among his priests: * and Samuel among them that call upon his name.

verses.lat: 98:6 Invocábant Dóminum, et ipse exaudiébat eos: * in colúmna nubis loquebátur ad eos.
verses.eng: 98:6 They called upon the Lord, and he heard them: * he spoke to them in the pillar of the cloud.

verses.lat: 98:7 Custodiébant testimónia ejus, * et præcéptum quod dedit illis.
verses.eng: 98:7 They kept his testimonies, * and the commandment which he gave them.

verses.lat: 98:8 Dómine, Deus noster, tu exaudiébas eos: * Deus, tu propítius fuísti eis, et ulcíscens in omnes adinventiónes eórum.
verses.eng: 98:8 Thou didst hear them, O Lord our God: * thou wast a merciful God to them, and taking vengeance on all their inventions.

verses.lat: 98:9 Exaltáte Dóminum, Deum nostrum, et adoráte in monte sancto ejus: * quóniam sanctus Dóminus, Deus noster.
verses.eng: 98:9 Exalt ye the Lord our God, and adore at his holy mountain: * for the Lord our God is holy.

laudes.antiphon.psalm1.label: Antíphona
laudes.antiphon.psalm1.lat: Exaltáte * Dóminum Deum nostrum, et adoráte in monte sancto ejus.
laudes.antiphon.psalm1.eng: Exalt ye the Lord * our God, and worship him upon his holy mountain.

laudes.psalm2.label: Psalmus 142
laudes.psalm2.antiphonLat: Éripe me * de inimícis meis, Dómine, ad te confúgi.
laudes.psalm2.antiphonEng: Deliver me from my enemies, * O Lord, to thee have I fled.

verses.lat: 142:1 Dómine, exáudi oratiónem meam: áuribus pércipe obsecratiónem meam in veritáte tua: * exáudi me in tua justítia.
verses.eng: 142:1 Hear, O Lord, my prayer: give ear to my supplication in thy truth: * hear me in thy justice.

verses.lat: 142:2 Et non intres in judícium cum servo tuo: * quia non justificábitur in conspéctu tuo omnis vivens.
verses.eng: 142:2 And enter not into judgment with thy servant: * for in thy sight no man living shall be justified.

verses.lat: 142:3a Quia persecútus est inimícus ánimam meam: * humiliávit in terra vitam meam.
verses.eng: 142:3a For the enemy hath persecuted my soul: * he hath brought down my life to the earth.

verses.lat: 142:3b Collocávit me in obscúris sicut mórtuos sǽculi: * (4) et anxiátus est super me spíritus meus, in me turbátum est cor meum.
verses.eng: 142:3b He hath made me to dwell in darkness as those that have been dead of old: * (4) and my spirit is in anguish within me: my heart within me is troubled.

verses.lat: 142:5 Memor fui diérum antiquórum, meditátus sum in ómnibus opéribus tuis: * in factis mánuum tuárum meditábar.
verses.eng: 142:5 I remembered the days of old, I meditated on all thy works: * I meditated upon the works of thy hands.

verses.lat: 142:6 Expándi manus meas ad te: * ánima mea sicut terra sine aqua tibi.
verses.eng: 142:6 I stretched forth my hands to thee: * my soul is as earth without water unto thee.

verses.lat: 142:7a Velóciter exáudi me, Dómine: * defécit spíritus meus.
verses.eng: 142:7a Hear me speedily, O Lord: * my spirit hath fainted away.

verses.lat: 142:7b Non avértas fáciem tuam a me: * et símilis ero descendéntibus in lacum.
verses.eng: 142:7b Turn not away thy face from me, * lest I be like unto them that go down into the pit.

verses.lat: 142:8a Audítam fac mihi mane misericórdiam tuam: * quia in te sperávi.
verses.eng: 142:8a Cause me to hear thy mercy in the morning; * for in thee have I hoped.

verses.lat: 142:8b Notam fac mihi viam, in qua ámbulem: * quia ad te levávi ánimam meam.
verses.eng: 142:8b Make the way known to me, wherein I should walk: * for I have lifted up my soul to thee.

verses.lat: 142:9 Éripe me de inimícis meis, Dómine, ad te confúgi: * (10a) doce me fácere voluntátem tuam, quia Deus meus es tu.
verses.eng: 142:9 Deliver me from my enemies, O Lord, to thee have I fled: * (10a) teach me to do thy will, for thou art my God.

verses.lat: 142:10b Spíritus tuus bonus dedúcet me in terram rectam: * (11a) propter nomen tuum, Dómine, vivificábis me, in æquitáte tua.
verses.eng: 142:10b Thy good spirit shall lead me into the right land: * (11a) for thy name’s sake, O Lord, thou wilt quicken me in thy justice.

verses.lat: 142:11b Edúces de tribulatióne ánimam meam: * (12a) et in misericórdia tua dispérdes inimícos meos.
verses.eng: 142:11b Thou wilt bring my soul out of trouble: * (12a) and in thy mercy thou wilt destroy my enemies.

verses.lat: 142:12b Et perdes omnes, qui tríbulant ánimam meam: * quóniam ego servus tuus sum.
verses.eng: 142:12b And thou wilt cut off all them that afflict my soul: * for I am thy servant.

laudes.antiphon.psalm2.label: Antíphona
laudes.antiphon.psalm2.lat: Éripe me * de inimícis meis, Dómine, ad te confúgi.
laudes.antiphon.psalm2.eng: Deliver me from my enemies, * O Lord, to thee have I fled.

laudes.psalm3.label: Psalmus 84
laudes.psalm3.antiphonLat: Benedixísti, * Dómine, terram tuam: remisísti iniquitátem plebis tuæ.
laudes.psalm3.antiphonEng: Lord, thou hast blessed thy land; * Thou hast forgiven the iniquity of thy people.

verses.lat: 84:2 Benedixísti, Dómine, terram tuam: * avertísti captivitátem Jacob.
verses.eng: 84:2 Lord, thou hast blessed thy land: * thou hast turned away the captivity of Jacob.

verses.lat: 84:3 Remisísti iniquitátem plebis tuæ: * operuísti ómnia peccáta eórum.
verses.eng: 84:3 Thou hast forgiven the iniquity of thy people: * thou hast covered all their sins.

verses.lat: 84:4 Mitigásti omnem iram tuam: * avertísti ab ira indignatiónis tuæ.
verses.eng: 84:4 Thou hast mitigated all thy anger: * thou hast turned away from the wrath of thy indignation.

verses.lat: 84:5 Convérte nos, Deus, salutáris noster: * et avérte iram tuam a nobis.
verses.eng: 84:5 Convert us, O God our saviour: * and turn off thy anger from us.

verses.lat: 84:6 Numquid in ætérnum irascéris nobis? * aut exténdes iram tuam a generatióne in generatiónem?
verses.eng: 84:6 Wilt thou be angry with us for ever: * or wilt thou extend thy wrath from generation to generation?

verses.lat: 84:7 Deus, tu convérsus vivificábis nos: * et plebs tua lætábitur in te.
verses.eng: 84:7 Thou wilt turn, O God, and bring us to life: * and thy people shall rejoice in thee.

verses.lat: 84:8 Osténde nobis, Dómine, misericórdiam tuam: * et salutáre tuum da nobis.
verses.eng: 84:8 Shew us, O Lord, thy mercy; * and grant us thy salvation.

verses.lat: 84:9 Áudiam quid loquátur in me Dóminus Deus: * quóniam loquétur pacem in plebem suam.
verses.eng: 84:9 I will hear what the Lord God will speak in me: * for he will speak peace

verses.lat: 84:9 Et super sanctos suos: * et in eos, qui convertúntur ad cor.
verses.eng: 84:9 And unto his saints: * and unto them that are converted to the heart.

verses.lat: 84:10 Verúmtamen prope timéntes eum salutáre ipsíus: * ut inhábitet glória in terra nostra.
verses.eng: 84:10 Surely his salvation is near to them that fear him: * that glory may dwell in our land.

verses.lat: 84:11 Misericórdia, et véritas obviavérunt sibi: * justítia, et pax osculátæ sunt.
verses.eng: 84:11 Mercy and truth have met each other: * justice and peace have kissed.

verses.lat: 84:12 Véritas de terra orta est: * et justítia de cælo prospéxit.
verses.eng: 84:12 Truth is sprung out of the earth: * and justice hath looked down from heaven.

verses.lat: 84:13 Étenim Dóminus dabit benignitátem: * et terra nostra dabit fructum suum.
verses.eng: 84:13 For the Lord will give goodness: * and our earth shall yield her fruit.

verses.lat: 84:14 Justítia ante eum ambulábit: * et ponet in via gressus suos.
verses.eng: 84:14 Justice shall walk before him: * and shall set his steps in the way.

laudes.antiphon.psalm3.label: Antíphona
laudes.antiphon.psalm3.lat: Benedixísti, * Dómine, terram tuam: remisísti iniquitátem plebis tuæ.
laudes.antiphon.psalm3.eng: Lord, thou hast blessed thy land; * Thou hast forgiven the iniquity of thy people.

laudes.canticle1.label: Canticum 215
laudes.canticle1.antiphonLat: In Dómino justificábitur * et laudábitur omne semen Israël.
laudes.canticle1.antiphonEng: In the Lord * shall all the seed of Israel be justified and praised.

verses.lat: (Canticum Isaiæ * Isa 45:15-30)
verses.eng: (Canticle of_Isaias * Isa 45:15-30)

verses.lat: 45:15 Vere tu es Deus abscónditus, * Deus Israël, Salvátor.
verses.eng: 45:15 Verily thou art a hidden God, * the God of Israel the saviour.

verses.lat: 45:16 Confúsi sunt, et erubuérunt omnes: * simul abiérunt in confusiónem fabricatóres errórum.
verses.eng: 45:16 They are all confounded and ashamed: * the forgers of errors are gone together into confusion.

verses.lat: 45:17 Israël salvátus est in Dómino salúte ætérna: * non confundémini, et non erubescétis usque in sǽculum sǽculi.
verses.eng: 45:17 Israel is saved in the Lord with an eternal salvation: * you shall not be confounded, and you shall not be ashamed for ever and ever.

verses.lat: 45:18 Quia hæc dicit Dóminus creans cælos, * ipse Deus formans terram, et fáciens eam, ipse plastes ejus:
verses.eng: 45:18 For thus saith the Lord that created the heavens, * God himself that formed the earth, and made it, the very maker thereof:

verses.lat: 45:19 Non in vanum creávit eam, ut habitarétur, formávit eam: * Ego Dóminus, et non est álius.
verses.eng: 45:19 He did not create it in vain: he formed it to be inhabited. * I am the Lord, and there is no other.

verses.lat: 45:20 Non in abscóndito locútus sum, * in loco terræ tenebróso:
verses.eng: 45:20 I have not spoken in secret, * in a dark place of the earth:

verses.lat: 45:21 Non dixi sémini Jacob frustra: Quǽrite me: * ego Dóminus loquens justítiam, annúntians recta.
verses.eng: 45:21 I have not said to the seed of Jacob: Seek me in vain. * I am the Lord that speak justice, that declare right things.

verses.lat: 45:22 Congregámini, et veníte, et accédite simul * qui salváti estis ex géntibus:
verses.eng: 45:22 Assemble yourselves, and come, and draw near together, * ye that are saved of the Gentiles:

verses.lat: 45:23 Nesciérunt qui levant lignum sculptúræ suæ, * et rogant deum non salvántem.
verses.eng: 45:23 They have no knowledge that set up the wood of their graven work, * and pray to a god that cannot save.

verses.lat: 45:24 Annuntiáte, et veníte, et consiliámini simul: * Quis audítum fecit hoc ab inítio, ex tunc prædíxit illud?
verses.eng: 45:24 Tell ye, and come, and consult together: * who hath declared this from the beginning, who hath foretold this from that time?

verses.lat: 45:25 Numquid non ego Dóminus, et non est ultra Deus absque me? * Deus justus, et salvans non est præter me.
verses.eng: 45:25 Have not I the Lord, and there is no God else besides me? * A just God and a saviour, there is none besides me.

verses.lat: 45:26 Convertímini ad me, et salvi éritis, omnes fines terræ: * quia ego Deus, et non est álius.
verses.eng: 45:26 Be converted to me, and you shall be saved, all ye ends of the earth: * for I am God, and there is no other.

verses.lat: 45:27 In memetípso jurávi, egrediétur de ore meo justítiæ verbum, * et non revertétur:
verses.eng: 45:27 I have sworn by myself, the word of justice shall go out of my mouth, * and shall not return:

verses.lat: 45:28 Quia mihi curvábitur omne genu, * et jurábit omnis lingua.
verses.eng: 45:28 For every knee shall be bowed to me, * and every tongue shall swear.

verses.lat: 45:29 Ergo in Dómino, dicet, meæ sunt justítiæ et impérium: * ad eum vénient, et confundéntur omnes qui repúgnant ei.
verses.eng: 45:29 Therefore shall he say: In the Lord are my justices and empire: * they shall come to him, and all that resist him shall be confounded.

verses.lat: 45:30 In Dómino justificábitur, et laudábitur * omne semen Israël.
verses.eng: 45:30 In the Lord shall all the seed * of Israel be justified and praised.

laudes.antiphon.psalm4.label: Antíphona
laudes.antiphon.psalm4.lat: In Dómino justificábitur * et laudábitur omne semen Israël.
laudes.antiphon.psalm4.eng: In the Lord * shall all the seed of Israel be justified and praised.

verses.lat: 147:1 Lauda, Jerúsalem, Dóminum: * lauda Deum tuum, Sion.
verses.eng: 147:1 Praise the Lord, O Jerusalem: * praise thy God, O Sion.

verses.lat: 147:2 Quóniam confortávit seras portárum tuárum: * benedíxit fíliis tuis in te.
verses.eng: 147:2 Because he hath strengthened the bolts of thy gates * he hath blessed thy children within thee.

verses.lat: 147:3 Qui pósuit fines tuos pacem: * et ádipe fruménti sátiat te.
verses.eng: 147:3 Who hath placed peace in thy borders: * and filleth thee with the fat of corn.

verses.lat: 147:4 Qui emíttit elóquium suum terræ: * velóciter currit sermo ejus.
verses.eng: 147:4 Who sendeth forth his speech to the earth: * his word runneth swiftly.

verses.lat: 147:5 Qui dat nivem sicut lanam: * nébulam sicut cínerem spargit.
verses.eng: 147:5 Who giveth snow like wool: * scattereth mists like ashes.

verses.lat: 147:6 Mittit crystállum suam sicut buccéllas: * ante fáciem frígoris ejus quis sustinébit?
verses.eng: 147:6 He sendeth his crystal like morsels: * who shall stand before the face of his cold?

verses.lat: 147:7 Emíttet verbum suum, et liquefáciet ea: * flabit spíritus ejus, et fluent aquæ.
verses.eng: 147:7 He shall send out his word, and shall melt them: * his wind shall blow, and the waters shall run.

verses.lat: 147:8 Qui annúntiat verbum suum Jacob: * justítias, et judícia sua Israël.
verses.eng: 147:8 Who declareth his word to Jacob: * his justices and his judgments to Israel.

verses.lat: 147:9 Non fecit táliter omni natióni: * et judícia sua non manifestávit eis.
verses.eng: 147:9 He hath not done in like manner to every nation: * and his judgments he hath not made manifest to them.

vesperae.capitulum.label: Capitulum (2 Cor 1:3-4)
vesperae.capitulum.lat: Benedíctus Deus, et Pater Dómini nostri Jesu Christi, Pater misericordiárum, et Deus totíus consolatiónis, qui consolátur nos in omni tribulatióne nostra.
vesperae.capitulum.eng: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of mercies, and the God of all comfort, who comforteth us in all our tribulation.

capitulum_laudes.label: Capitulum (Rom 13:12-13)
capitulum_laudes.lat: Nox præcéssit, dies autem appropinquávit. Abiciámus ergo ópera tenebrárum, et induámur arma lucis. Sicut in die honéste ambulémus.
capitulum_laudes.eng: The night is passed, and the day is at hand. Let us therefore cast off the works of darkness, and put on the armour of light. Let us walk honestly, as in the day.

versum_tertia.label: Versiculus
versum_tertia.lat: ℣. Adjútor meus, esto, ne derelínquas me.
versum_tertia.eng: ℣. Be Thou my helper, forsake me not.
versum_tertia.latR: ℟. Neque despícias me, Deus, salutáris meus.
versum_tertia.engR: ℟. Do not Thou despise me, O God my Saviour.

versum_sexta.label: Versiculus
versum_sexta.lat: ℣. Dóminus regit me, et nihil mihi déerit.
versum_sexta.eng: ℣. The Lord ruleth me: and I shall want nothing.
versum_sexta.latR: ℟. In loco páscuæ ibi me collocávit.
versum_sexta.engR: ℟. He hath set me in a place of pasture.

versum_nona.label: Versiculus
versum_nona.lat: ℣. Ab occúltis meis munda me, Dómine.
versum_nona.eng: ℣. From my secret ones cleanse me, O Lord.
versum_nona.latR: ℟. Et ab aliénis parce servo tuo.
versum_nona.engR: ℟. And from those of others spare Thy servant.

ant_1.label: Antíphona
ant_1.lat: Suscitávit Dóminus * testimónium in Jacob: et legem pósuit in Israël.
ant_1.eng: The Lord set up a testimony in Jacob: * and made a law in Israel.

ant_2.label: Antíphona
ant_2.lat: Deus adjútor * est eórum: et Excélsus redémptor eórum est.
ant_2.eng: God is their helper, * and the most high God their redeemer.

ant_3.label: Antíphona
ant_3.lat: Ádjuva nos, * Deus, salutáris noster: et propítius esto peccátis nostris.
ant_3.eng: Help us, O God, our Saviour, * deliver us: and forgive us our sins.

nocturn_1_versum.label: Versicle after Nocturn I
nocturn_1_versum.lat: ℣. Deus percússit petram et fluxérunt aquæ.
nocturn_1_versum.eng: ℣. He struck the rock, and the waters gushed out.

nocturn_2_versum.label: Versicle after Nocturn II
nocturn_2_versum.eng: ℣. The Lord chose the tribe of Juda.

nocturn_3_versum.label: Versicle after Nocturn III
nocturn_3_versum.latR: ℟. Tu solus Altíssimus super omnem terram.
nocturn_3_versum.eng: ℣. Let them know that the Lord is thy name.
nocturn_3_versum.engR: ℟. Thou alone art the most High over all the earth.

hymnus_laudes.label: Hymn
hymnus_laudes.title: Ætérna cæli glória
hymnus_laudes.lat:
Ætérna cæli glória,
Beáta spes mortálium,
Summi Tonántis Únice,
Castǽque proles Vírginis:

Da déxteram surgéntibus,
Exsúrgat et mens sóbria,
Flagrans et in laudem Dei
Grates repéndat débitas.

Ortus refúlget Lúcifer,
Præítque solem núntius:
Cadunt tenébræ nóctium:
Lux sancta nos illúminet.

Manénsque nostris sénsibus,
Noctem repéllat sǽculi,
Omníque fine témporis
Purgáta servet péctora.

Quæsíta jam primum fides
In corde radíces agat:
Secúnda spes congáudeat,
Qua major exstat cáritas.

Deo Patri sit glória,
Ejúsque soli Fílio,
Cum Spíritu Paráclito,
Nunc et per omne sǽculum.
Amen.
hymnus_laudes.eng:
O Christ, whose glory fills the heaven,
Our only hope, in mercy given;
Child of a Virgin meek and pure;
Son of the Highest evermore:

Grant us thine aid thy praise to sing,
As opening days new duties bring;
That with the light our life may be
Renewed and sanctified by thee.

The morning star fades from the sky,
The sun breaks forth; night’s shadows fly:
O Thou, true Light, upon us shine:
Our darkness turn to light divine.

Within us grant thy light to dwell;
And from our souls dark sins expel;
Cleanse thou our minds from stain of ill,
And with thy peace our bosoms fill.

To us strong faith forever give,
With joyous hope, in thee to live;
That life’s rough way may ever be
Made strong and pure by charity.

All laud to God the Father be,
All praise, Eternal Son, to thee:
All glory, as is ever meet,
To God the holy Paraclete,
Amen.

hymnus_vespera.label: Hymn
hymnus_vespera.title: Hóminis superne Cónditor
hymnus_vespera.lat:
Hóminis superne Cónditor,
Qui cuncta solus órdinans,
Humum jubes prodúcere
Reptántis et feræ genus:

Et magna rerum córpora,
Dictu jubéntis vívida,
Per témporum certas vices
Obtemperáre sérvulis:

Repélle, quod cupídinis
Ciénte vi nos ímpetit,
Aut móribus se súggerit,
Aut áctibus se intérserit.

Da gaudiórum prǽmia,
Da gratiárum múnera:
Dissólve litis víncula:
Astrínge pacis fœ́dera.

Præsta, Pater piíssime,
Patríque compar Únice,
Cum Spíritu Paráclito
Regnans per omne sǽculum.
Amen.
hymnus_vespera.eng:
Maker of man, who from thy throne
Dost order all things, God alone;
By whose decree the teeming earth
To reptile and to beast gave birth:

The mighty forms that fill the land,
Instinct with life at thy command,
Are given subdued to humankind
For service in their rank assigned.

From all thy servants drive away
Whate’er of thought impure to-day
Hath been with open action blent,
Or mingled with the heart’s intent.

In heaven thine endless joys bestow,
And grant thy gifts of grace below;
From chains of strife our souls release,
Bind fast the gentle bands of peace.

Grant this, O Father, ever One
With Christ, thy sole-begotten Son,
Whom, with the Spirit we adore,
One God, both now and evermore.
Amen.

ant_laudes.label: Antiphon ad Benedictus
ant_laudes.lat: Per víscera misericórdiæ * Dei nostri visitávit nos Óriens ex alto.
ant_laudes.eng: Through the tender mercy * of our God, the dayspring from on high has visited us.

ant_vespera.label: Antiphon ad Magnificat
ant_vespera.lat: Depósuit Dóminus * poténtes de sede, et exaltávit húmiles.
ant_vespera.eng: The Lord has put down * the mighty from their seat, and exalted the humble and meek.

versum_1.label: Versicle
versum_1.eng: We are filled in the morning with thy mercy.
versum_1.engR: And we have rejoiced, and are delighted.

matutinum.psalm2.label: Psalmus 104 (1-15)

verses.lat: 104:1 Confitémini Dómino, et invocáte nomen ejus: * annuntiáte inter gentes ópera ejus.
verses.eng: 104:1 Give glory to the Lord, and call upon his name: * declare his deeds among the Gentiles.

verses.lat: 104:2 Cantáte ei, et psállite ei: * narráte ómnia mirabília ejus.
verses.eng: 104:2 Sing to him, yea sing praises to him: * relate all his wondrous works.

verses.lat: 104:3 Laudámini in nómine sancto ejus: * lætétur cor quæréntium Dóminum.
verses.eng: 104:3 Glory ye in his holy name: * let the heart of them rejoice that seek the Lord.

verses.lat: 104:4 Quǽrite Dóminum, et confirmámini: * quǽrite fáciem ejus semper.
verses.eng: 104:4 Seek ye the Lord, and be strengthened: * seek his face evermore.

verses.lat: 104:5 Mementóte mirabílium ejus, quæ fecit: * prodígia ejus, et judícia oris ejus.
verses.eng: 104:5 Remember his marvellous works which he hath done; * his wonders, and the judgments of his mouth.

verses.lat: 104:6 Semen Ábraham, servi ejus: * fílii Jacob, elécti ejus.
verses.eng: 104:6 O ye seed of Abraham his servant; * ye sons of Jacob his chosen.

verses.lat: 104:7 Ipse Dóminus Deus noster: * in univérsa terra judícia ejus.
verses.eng: 104:7 He is the Lord our God: * his judgments are in all the earth.

verses.lat: 104:8 Memor fuit in sǽculum testaménti sui: * verbi, quod mandávit in mille generatiónes:
verses.eng: 104:8 He hath remembered his covenant for ever: * the word which he commanded to a thousand generations.

verses.lat: 104:9 Quod dispósuit ad Ábraham: * et juraménti sui ad Isaac:
verses.eng: 104:9 Which he made to Abraham; * and his oath to Isaac:

verses.lat: 104:10 Et státuit illud Jacob in præcéptum: * et Israël in testaméntum ætérnum:
verses.eng: 104:10 And he appointed the same to Jacob for a law, * and to Israel for an everlasting testament:

verses.lat: 104:11 Dicens: Tibi dabo terram Chánaan, * funículum hereditátis vestræ.
verses.eng: 104:11 Saying: To thee will I give the land of Chanaan, * the lot of your inheritance.

verses.lat: 104:12 Cum essent número brevi, * paucíssimi et íncolæ ejus:
verses.eng: 104:12 When they were but a small number: * yea very few, and sojourners therein:

verses.lat: 104:13 Et pertransiérunt de gente in gentem, * et de regno ad pópulum álterum.
verses.eng: 104:13 And they passed from nation to nation, * and from one kingdom to another people.

verses.lat: 104:14 Non relíquit hóminem nocére eis: * et corrípuit pro eis reges.
verses.eng: 104:14 He suffered no man to hurt them: * and he reproved kings for their sakes.

verses.lat: 104:15 Nolíte tángere christos meos: * et in prophétis meis nolíte malignári.
verses.eng: 104:15 Touch ye not my anointed: * and do no evil to my prophets.

matutinum.psalm2.antiphonLat: Memor fuit in sǽculum * testaménti sui Dóminus Deus noster.
matutinum.psalm2.antiphonEng: The memory of thy testament * will live forever, O Lord our God.

matutinum.psalm3.label: Psalmus 104 (16-27)

verses.lat: 104:16 Et vocávit famem super terram: * et omne firmaméntum panis contrívit.
verses.eng: 104:16 And he called a famine upon the land: * and he broke in pieces all the support of bread.

verses.lat: 104:17 Misit ante eos virum: * in servum venúmdatus est Joseph.
verses.eng: 104:17 He sent a man before them: * Joseph, who was sold for a slave.

verses.lat: 104:18 Humiliavérunt in compédibus pedes ejus, ferrum pertránsiit ánimam ejus * donec veníret verbum ejus.
verses.eng: 104:18 They humbled his feet in fetters: the iron pierced his soul, * until his word came.

verses.lat: 104:19 Elóquium Dómini inflammávit eum: * misit rex, et solvit eum; princeps populórum, et dimísit eum.
verses.eng: 104:19 The word of the Lord inflamed him: * the king sent, and he released him: the ruler of the people, and he set him at liberty.

verses.lat: 104:21 Constítuit eum dóminum domus suæ: * et príncipem omnis possessiónis suæ:
verses.eng: 104:21 He made him master of his house, * and ruler of all his possession.

verses.lat: 104:22 Ut erudíret príncipes ejus sicut semetípsum: * et senes ejus prudéntiam docéret.
verses.eng: 104:22 That he might instruct his princes as himself, * and teach his ancients wisdom.

verses.lat: 104:23 Et intrávit Israël in Ægýptum: * et Jacob áccola fuit in terra Cham.
verses.eng: 104:23 And Israel went into Egypt: * and Jacob was a sojourner in the land of Cham.

verses.lat: 104:24 Et auxit pópulum suum veheménter: * et firmávit eum super inimícos ejus.
verses.eng: 104:24 And he increased his people exceedingly: * and strengthened them over their enemies,

verses.lat: 104:25 Convértit cor eórum ut odírent pópulum ejus: * et dolum fácerent in servos ejus.
verses.eng: 104:25 He turned their heart to hate his people: * and to deal deceitfully with his servants.

verses.lat: 104:26 Misit Móysen, servum suum: * Aaron, quem elégit ipsum.
verses.eng: 104:26 He sent Moses his servant: * Aaron the man whom he had chosen.

verses.lat: 104:27 Pósuit in eis verba signórum suórum: * et prodigiórum in terra Cham.
verses.eng: 104:27 He gave them power to shew his signs, * and his wonders in the land of Cham.

matutinum.psalm3.antiphonLat: Auxit Dóminus * pópulum suum: et firmávit eum super inimícos ejus.
matutinum.psalm3.antiphonEng: The Lord increased his people exceedingly * and strengthened them over their enemies.

matutinum.psalm4.label: Psalmus 104 (28-45)

verses.lat: 104:28 Misit ténebras, et obscurávit: * et non exacerbávit sermónes suos.
verses.eng: 104:28 He sent darkness, and made it obscure: * and grieved not his words.

verses.lat: 104:29 Convértit aquas eórum in sánguinem: * et occídit pisces eórum.
verses.eng: 104:29 He turned their waters into blood, * and destroyed their fish.

verses.lat: 104:30 Édidit terra eórum ranas: * in penetrálibus regum ipsórum.
verses.eng: 104:30 Their land brought forth frogs, * in the inner chambers of their kings.

verses.lat: 104:31 Dixit, et venit cœnomyía: * et cínifes in ómnibus fínibus eórum.
verses.eng: 104:31 He spoke, and there came diverse sorts of flies, * and sciniphs in all their coasts.

verses.lat: 104:32 Pósuit plúvias eórum grándinem: * ignem comburéntem in terra ipsórum.
verses.eng: 104:32 He gave them hail for rain, * a burning fire in the land.

verses.lat: 104:33 Et percússit víneas eórum, et ficúlneas eórum: * et contrívit lignum fínium eórum.
verses.eng: 104:33 And he destroyed their vineyards, and their fig trees: * and he broke in pieces the trees of their coasts.

verses.lat: 104:34 Dixit, et venit locústa, et bruchus, * cujus non erat númerus:
verses.eng: 104:34 He spoke, and the locust came, and the bruchus, * of which there was no number.

verses.lat: 104:35 Et comédit omne fænum in terra eórum: * et comédit omnem fructum terræ eórum.
verses.eng: 104:35 And they devoured all the grass in their land, * and consumed all the fruit of their ground.

verses.lat: 104:36 Et percússit omne primogénitum in terra eórum: * primítias omnis labóris eórum.
verses.eng: 104:36 And he slew all the firstborn in their land: * the firstfruits of all their labour.

verses.lat: 104:37 Et edúxit eos cum argénto et auro: * et non erat in tríbubus eórum infírmus.
verses.eng: 104:37 And he brought them out with silver and gold: * and there was not among their tribes one that was feeble.

verses.lat: 104:38 Lætáta est Ægýptus in profectióne eórum: * quia incúbuit timor eórum super eos.
verses.eng: 104:38 Egypt was glad when they departed: * for the fear of them lay upon them.

verses.lat: 104:39 Expándit nubem in protectiónem eórum: * et ignem ut lucéret eis per noctem.
verses.eng: 104:39 He spread a cloud for their protection, * and fire to give them light in the night.

verses.lat: 104:40 Petiérunt, et venit cotúrnix: * et pane cæli saturávit eos.
verses.eng: 104:40 They asked, and the quail came: * and he filled them with the bread of heaven.

verses.lat: 104:41 Dirúpit petram et fluxérunt aquæ: * abiérunt in sicco flúmina;
verses.eng: 104:41 He opened the rock, and waters flowed: * rivers ran down in the dry land.

verses.lat: 104:42 Quóniam memor fuit verbi sancti sui: * quod hábuit ad Ábraham, púerum suum.
verses.eng: 104:42 Because he remembered his holy word, * which he had spoken to his servant Abraham.

verses.lat: 104:43 Et edúxit pópulum suum in exsultatióne, * et eléctos suos in lætítia.
verses.eng: 104:43 And he brought forth his people with joy, * and his chosen with gladness.

verses.lat: 104:44 Et dedit illis regiónes géntium: * et labóres populórum possedérunt:
verses.eng: 104:44 And he gave them the lands of the Gentiles: * and they possessed the labours of the people:

verses.lat: 104:45 Ut custódiant justificatiónes ejus, * et legem ejus requírant.
verses.eng: 104:45 That they might observe his justifications, * and seek after his law.

matutinum.psalm4.antiphonLat: Edúxit Deus * pópulum suum in exsultatióne, et eléctos suos in lætítia.
matutinum.psalm4.antiphonEng: The Lord brought forth * his people with joy, and his chosen with gladness.

matutinum.psalm5.label: Psalmus 105 (1-15)

verses.lat: 105:1 Confitémini Dómino, quóniam bonus: * quóniam in sǽculum misericórdia ejus.
verses.eng: 105:1 Give glory to the Lord, for he is good: * for his mercy endureth for ever.

verses.lat: 105:2 Quis loquétur poténtias Dómini, * audítas fáciet omnes laudes ejus?
verses.eng: 105:2 Who shall declare the powers of the Lord? * who shall set forth all his praises?

verses.lat: 105:3 Beáti, qui custódiunt judícium, * et fáciunt justítiam in omni témpore.
verses.eng: 105:3 Blessed are they that keep judgment, * and do justice at all times.

verses.lat: 105:4 Meménto nostri, Dómine, in beneplácito pópuli tui: * vísita nos in salutári tuo:
verses.eng: 105:4 Remember us, O Lord, in the favour of thy people: * visit us with thy salvation.

verses.lat: 105:5 Ad vidéndum in bonitáte electórum tuórum, ad lætándum in lætítia gentis tuæ: * ut laudéris cum hereditáte tua.
verses.eng: 105:5 That we may see the good of thy chosen, that we may rejoice in the joy of thy nation: * that thou mayst be praised with thy inheritance.

verses.lat: 105:6 Peccávimus cum pátribus nostris: * injúste égimus, iniquitátem fécimus.
verses.eng: 105:6 We have sinned with our fathers: * we have acted unjustly, we have wrought iniquity.

verses.lat: 105:7 Patres nostri in Ægýpto non intellexérunt mirabília tua: * non fuérunt mémores multitúdinis misericórdiæ tuæ.
verses.eng: 105:7 Our fathers understood not thy wonders in Egypt: * they remembered not the multitude of thy mercies:

verses.lat: 105:7 Et irritavérunt ascendéntes in mare, * Mare Rubrum.
verses.eng: 105:7 And they provoked to wrath going up to the sea, * even the Red Sea.

verses.lat: 105:8 Et salvávit eos propter nomen suum: * ut notam fáceret poténtiam suam.
verses.eng: 105:8 And he saved them for his own name’s sake: * that he might make his power known.

verses.lat: 105:9 Et incrépuit Mare Rubrum, et exsiccátum est, * et dedúxit eos in abýssis sicut in desérto.
verses.eng: 105:9 And he rebuked the Red Sea, and it was dried up: * and he led them through the depths, as in a wilderness.

verses.lat: 105:10 Et salvávit eos de manu odiéntium: * et redémit eos de manu inimíci.
verses.eng: 105:10 And he saved them from the hand of them that hated them: * and he redeemed them from the hand of the enemy.

verses.lat: 105:11 Et opéruit aqua tribulántes eos: * unus ex eis non remánsit.
verses.eng: 105:11 And the water covered them that afflicted them: * there was not one of them left.

verses.lat: 105:12 Et credidérunt verbis ejus: * et laudavérunt laudem ejus.
verses.eng: 105:12 And they believed his words: * and they sang his praises.

verses.lat: 105:13 Cito fecérunt, oblíti sunt óperum ejus: * et non sustinuérunt consílium ejus.
verses.eng: 105:13 They had quickly done, they forgot his works: * and they waited not for his counsels.

verses.lat: 105:14 Et concupiérunt concupiscéntiam in desérto: * et tentavérunt Deum in inaquóso.
verses.eng: 105:14 And they coveted their desire in the desert: * and they tempted God in the place without water.

verses.lat: 105:15 Et dedit eis petitiónem ipsórum: * et misit saturitátem in ánimas eórum.
verses.eng: 105:15 And he gave them their request: * and sent fulness into their souls.

matutinum.psalm5.antiphonLat: Salvávit eos Dóminus * propter nomen suum.
matutinum.psalm5.antiphonEng: The Lord saved them * for his own name's sake.

matutinum.psalm6.label: Psalmus 105 (16-31)

verses.lat: 105:16 Et irritavérunt Móysen in castris: * Aaron, sanctum Dómini.
verses.eng: 105:16 And they provoked Moses in the camp, * Aaron the holy one of the Lord.

verses.lat: 105:17 Apérta est terra, et deglutívit Dathan: * et opéruit super congregatiónem Abíron.
verses.eng: 105:17 The earth opened and swallowed up Dathan: * and covered the congregation of Abiron.

verses.lat: 105:18 Et exársit ignis in synagóga eórum * flamma combússit peccatóres.
verses.eng: 105:18 And a fire was kindled in their congregation: * the flame burned the wicked.

verses.lat: 105:19 Et fecérunt vítulum in Horeb * et adoravérunt scúlptile.
verses.eng: 105:19 They made also a calf in Horeb: * and they adored the graven thing.

verses.lat: 105:20 Et mutavérunt glóriam suam * in similitúdinem vítuli comedéntis fænum.
verses.eng: 105:20 And they changed their glory * into the likeness of a calf that eateth grass.

verses.lat: 105:21 Oblíti sunt Deum, qui salvávit eos, * qui fecit magnália in Ægýpto, mirabília in terra Cham: terribília in Mari Rubro.
verses.eng: 105:21 They forgot God, who saved them, * who had done great things in Egypt, wondrous works in the land of Cham: terrible things in the Red Sea.

verses.lat: 105:23 Et dixit ut dispérderet eos: * si non Móyses, eléctus ejus, stetísset in confractióne in conspéctu ejus:
verses.eng: 105:23 And he said that he would destroy them: * had not Moses his chosen stood before him in the breach:

verses.lat: 105:24 Ut avérteret iram ejus ne dispérderet eos: * et pro níhilo habuérunt terram desiderábilem:
verses.eng: 105:24 To turn away his wrath, lest he should destroy them; * and they set at nought the desirable land.

verses.lat: 105:25 Non credidérunt verbo ejus, et murmuravérunt in tabernáculis suis: * non exaudiérunt vocem Dómini.
verses.eng: 105:25 They believed not his word, and they murmured in their tents: * they hearkened not to the voice of the Lord.

verses.lat: 105:26 Et elevávit manum suam super eos: * ut prostérneret eos in desérto:
verses.eng: 105:26 And he lifted up his hand over them: * to overthrow them in the desert;

verses.lat: 105:27 Et ut deíceret semen eórum in natiónibus: * et dispérgeret eos in regiónibus.
verses.eng: 105:27 And to cast down their seed among the nations, * and to scatter them in the countries.

verses.lat: 105:28 Et initiáti sunt Beélphegor: * et comedérunt sacrifícia mortuórum.
verses.eng: 105:28 They also were initiated to Beelphegor: * and ate the sacrifices of the dead.

verses.lat: 105:29 Et irritavérunt eum in adinventiónibus suis: * et multiplicáta est in eis ruína.
verses.eng: 105:29 And they provoked him with their inventions: * and destruction was multiplied among them.

verses.lat: 105:30 Et stetit Phínees, et placávit: * et cessávit quassátio.
verses.eng: 105:30 Then Phinees stood up, and pacified him: * and the slaughter ceased.

verses.lat: 105:31 Et reputátum est ei in justítiam: * in generatiónem et generatiónem usque in sempitérnum.
verses.eng: 105:31 And it was reputed to him unto justice, * to generation and generation for evermore.

matutinum.psalm6.antiphonLat: Oblíti sunt Deum * qui salvávit eos.
matutinum.psalm6.antiphonEng: They forgot God * who saved them.

matutinum.psalm7.label: Psalmus 105 (32-48)

verses.lat: 105:32 Et irritavérunt eum ad aquas contradictiónis: * et vexátus est Móyses propter eos: quia exacerbavérunt spíritum ejus.
verses.eng: 105:32 They provoked him also at the waters of contradiction: * and Moses was afflicted for their sakes: because they exasperated his spirit.

verses.lat: 105:33 Et distínxit in lábiis suis: * non disperdidérunt gentes, quas dixit Dóminus illis.
verses.eng: 105:33 And he distinguished with his lips; * they did not destroy the nations of which the Lord spoke unto them.

verses.lat: 105:35 Et commísti sunt inter gentes, et didicérunt ópera eórum: et serviérunt sculptílibus eórum: * et factum est illis in scándalum.
verses.eng: 105:35 And they were mingled among the heathens, and learned their works: and served their idols, * and it became a stumblingblock to them.

verses.lat: 105:37 Et immolavérunt fílios suos, * et fílias suas dæmóniis.
verses.eng: 105:37 And they sacrificed their sons, * and their daughters to devils.

verses.lat: 105:38 Et effudérunt sánguinem innocéntem: * sánguinem filiórum suórum et filiárum suárum, quas sacrificavérunt sculptílibus Chánaan.
verses.eng: 105:38 And they shed innocent blood: * the blood of their sons and of their daughters which they sacrificed to the idols of Chanaan.

verses.lat: 105:39 Et infécta est terra in sanguínibus, et contamináta est in opéribus eórum: * et fornicáti sunt in adinventiónibus suis.
verses.eng: 105:39 And the land was polluted with blood, and was defiled with their works: * and they went aside after their own inventions.

verses.lat: 105:40 Et irátus est furóre Dóminus in pópulum suum: * et abominátus est hereditátem suam.
verses.eng: 105:40 And the Lord was exceedingly angry with his people: * and he abhorred his inheritance.

verses.lat: 105:41 Et trádidit eos in manus géntium: * et domináti sunt eórum qui odérunt eos.
verses.eng: 105:41 And he delivered them into the hands of the nations: * and they that hated them had dominion over them.

verses.lat: 105:42 Et tribulavérunt eos inimíci eórum, et humiliáti sunt sub mánibus eórum: * sæpe liberávit eos.
verses.eng: 105:42 And their enemies afflicted them: and they were humbled under their hands: * many times did he deliver them.

verses.lat: 105:43 Ipsi autem exacerbavérunt eum in consílio suo: * et humiliáti sunt in iniquitátibus suis.
verses.eng: 105:43 But they provoked him with their counsel: * and they were brought low by their iniquities.

verses.lat: 105:44 Et vidit, cum tribularéntur: * et audívit oratiónem eórum.
verses.eng: 105:44 And he saw when they were in tribulation: * and he heard their prayer.

verses.lat: 105:45 Et memor fuit testaménti sui: * et pœnítuit eum secúndum multitúdinem misericórdiæ suæ.
verses.eng: 105:45 And he was mindful of his covenant: * and repented according to the multitude of his mercies.

verses.lat: 105:46 Et dedit eos in misericórdias * in conspéctu ómnium qui céperant eos.
verses.eng: 105:46 And he gave them unto mercies, * in the sight of all those that had made them captives.

verses.lat: 105:47 Salvos nos fac, Dómine, Deus noster: * et cóngrega nos de natiónibus:
verses.eng: 105:47 Save us, O Lord, our God: * and gather us from among nations:

verses.lat: 105:47 Ut confiteámur nómini sancto tuo: * et gloriémur in laude tua.
verses.eng: 105:47 That we may give thanks to thy holy name, * and may glory in thy praise.

verses.lat: 105:48 Benedíctus Dóminus, Deus Israël, a sǽculo et usque in sǽculum: * et dicet omnis pópulus: Fiat, fiat.
verses.eng: 105:48 Blessed be the Lord the God of Israel, from everlasting to everlasting: * and let all the people say: So be it, so be it.

matutinum.psalm7.antiphonLat: Cum tribularéntur * vidit Dóminus: et audívit oratiónem eórum.
matutinum.psalm7.antiphonEng: And he saw when they were in tribulation * and he heard their prayer.

matutinum.psalm8.label: Psalmus 106 (1-14)

verses.lat: 106:1 Confitémini Dómino quóniam bonus: * quóniam in sǽculum misericórdia ejus.
verses.eng: 106:1 Give glory to the Lord, for he is good: * for his mercy endureth for ever.

verses.lat: 106:2 Dicant qui redémpti sunt a Dómino, quos redémit de manu inimíci: * et de regiónibus congregávit eos:
verses.eng: 106:2 Let them say so that have been redeemed by the Lord, whom he hath redeemed from the hand of the enemy: * and gathered out of the countries.

verses.lat: 106:3 A solis ortu, et occásu: * ab aquilóne, et mari.
verses.eng: 106:3 From the rising and the setting of the sun, * from the north and from the sea.

verses.lat: 106:4 Erravérunt in solitúdine in inaquóso: * viam civitátis habitáculi non invenérunt.
verses.eng: 106:4 They wandered in a wilderness, in a place without water: * they found not the way of a city for their habitation.

verses.lat: 106:5 Esuriéntes, et sitiéntes: * ánima eórum in ipsis defécit.
verses.eng: 106:5 They were hungry and thirsty: * their soul fainted in them.

verses.lat: 106:6 Et clamavérunt ad Dóminum cum tribularéntur: * et de necessitátibus eórum erípuit eos.
verses.eng: 106:6 And they cried to the Lord in their tribulation: * and he delivered them out of their distresses.

verses.lat: 106:7 Et dedúxit eos in viam rectam: * ut irent in civitátem habitatiónis.
verses.eng: 106:7 And he led them into the right way: * that they might go to a city of habitation.

verses.lat: 106:8 Confiteántur Dómino misericórdiæ ejus: * et mirabília ejus fíliis hóminum.
verses.eng: 106:8 Let the mercies of the Lord give glory to him: * and his wonderful works to the children of men.

verses.lat: 106:9 Quia satiávit ánimam inánem: * et ánimam esuriéntem satiávit bonis.
verses.eng: 106:9 For he hath satisfied the empty soul, * and hath filled the hungry soul with good things.

verses.lat: 106:10 Sedéntes in ténebris, et umbra mortis: * vinctos in mendicitáte et ferro.
verses.eng: 106:10 Such as sat in darkness and in the shadow of death: * bound in want and in iron.

verses.lat: 106:11 Quia exacerbavérunt elóquia Dei: * et consílium Altíssimi irritavérunt.
verses.eng: 106:11 Because they had exasperated the words of God: * and provoked the counsel of the most High:

verses.lat: 106:12 Et humiliátum est in labóribus cor eórum: * infirmáti sunt, nec fuit qui adjuváret.
verses.eng: 106:12 And their heart was humbled with labours: * they were weakened, and there was none to help them.

verses.lat: 106:13 Et clamavérunt ad Dóminum cum tribularéntur: * et de necessitátibus eórum liberávit eos.
verses.eng: 106:13 Then they cried to the Lord in their affliction: * and he delivered them out of their distresses.

verses.lat: 106:14 Et edúxit eos de ténebris, et umbra mortis: * et víncula eórum disrúpit.
verses.eng: 106:14 And he brought them out of darkness, * and the shadow of death; and broke their bonds in sunder.

matutinum.psalm8.antiphonLat: Clamavérunt ad Dóminum * et de necessitátibus eórum liberávit eos.
matutinum.psalm8.antiphonEng: Then they cried to the Lord * and he delivered them out of their distresses.

matutinum.psalm9.label: Psalmus 106 (15-30)

verses.lat: 106:15 Confiteántur Dómino misericórdiæ ejus: * et mirabília ejus fíliis hóminum.
verses.eng: 106:15 Let the mercies of the Lord give glory to him, * and his wonderful works to the children of men.

verses.lat: 106:16 Quia contrívit portas ǽreas: * et vectes férreos confrégit.
verses.eng: 106:16 Because he hath broken gates of brass, * and burst the iron bars.

verses.lat: 106:17 Suscépit eos de via iniquitátis eórum: * propter injustítias enim suas humiliáti sunt.
verses.eng: 106:17 He took them out of the way of their iniquity: * for they were brought low for their injustices.

verses.lat: 106:18 Omnem escam abomináta est ánima eórum: * et appropinquavérunt usque ad portas mortis.
verses.eng: 106:18 Their soul abhorred all manner of meat: * and they drew nigh even to the gates of death.

verses.lat: 106:19 Et clamavérunt ad Dóminum cum tribularéntur: * et de necessitátibus eórum liberávit eos.
verses.eng: 106:19 And they cried to the Lord in their affliction: * and he delivered them out of their distresses.

verses.lat: 106:20 Misit verbum suum, et sanávit eos: * et erípuit eos de interitiónibus eórum.
verses.eng: 106:20 He sent his word, and healed them: * and delivered them from their destructions.

verses.lat: 106:21 Confiteántur Dómino misericórdiæ ejus: * et mirabília ejus fíliis hóminum.
verses.eng: 106:21 Let the mercies of the Lord give glory to him: * and his wonderful works to the children of men

verses.lat: 106:22 Et sacríficent sacrifícium laudis: * et annúntient ópera ejus in exsultatióne.
verses.eng: 106:22 And let them sacrifice the sacrifice of praise: * and declare his works with joy.

verses.lat: 106:23 Qui descéndunt mare in návibus, * faciéntes operatiónem in aquis multis.
verses.eng: 106:23 They that go down to the sea in ships, * doing business in the great waters:

verses.lat: 106:24 Ipsi vidérunt ópera Dómini, * et mirabília ejus in profúndo.
verses.eng: 106:24 These have seen the works of the Lord, * and his wonders in the deep.

verses.lat: 106:25 Dixit, et stetit spíritus procéllæ: * et exaltáti sunt fluctus ejus.
verses.eng: 106:25 He said the word, and there arose a storm of wind: * and the waves thereof were lifted up.

verses.lat: 106:26 Ascéndunt usque ad cælos, et descéndunt usque ad abýssos: * ánima eórum in malis tabescébat.
verses.eng: 106:26 They mount up to the heavens, and they go down to the depths: * their soul pined away with evils.

verses.lat: 106:27 Turbáti sunt, et moti sunt sicut ébrius: * et omnis sapiéntia eórum devoráta est.
verses.eng: 106:27 They were troubled, and reeled like a drunken man; * and all their wisdom was swallowed up.

verses.lat: 106:28 Et clamavérunt ad Dóminum cum tribularéntur: * et de necessitátibus eórum edúxit eos.
verses.eng: 106:28 And they cried to the Lord in their affliction: * and he brought them out of their distresses.

verses.lat: 106:29 Et státuit procéllam ejus in auram: * et siluérunt fluctus ejus.
verses.eng: 106:29 And he turned the storm into a breeze: * and its waves were still.

verses.lat: 106:30 Et lætáti sunt quia siluérunt: * et dedúxit eos in portum voluntátis eórum.
verses.eng: 106:30 And they rejoiced because they were still: * and he brought them to the haven which they wished for.

matutinum.psalm9.antiphonLat: Ipsi vidérunt * ópera Dei et mirabília ejus.
matutinum.psalm9.antiphonEng: These have seen * the works of the Lord, and his wonders.

matutinum.psalm10.label: Psalmus 106 (31-43)

verses.lat: 106:31 Confiteántur Dómino misericórdiæ ejus: * et mirabília ejus fíliis hóminum.
verses.eng: 106:31 Let the mercies of the Lord give glory to him, * and his wonderful works to the children of men.

verses.lat: 106:32 Et exáltent eum in ecclésia plebis: * et in cáthedra seniórum laudent eum.
verses.eng: 106:32 And let them exalt him in the church of the people: * and praise him in the chair of the ancients.

verses.lat: 106:33 Pósuit flúmina in desértum: * et éxitus aquárum in sitim.
verses.eng: 106:33 He hath turned rivers into a wilderness: * and the sources of water into dry ground:

verses.lat: 106:34 Terram fructíferam in salsúginem: * a malítia inhabitántium in ea.
verses.eng: 106:34 A fruitful land into barrenness, * for the wickedness of them that dwell therein.

verses.lat: 106:35 Pósuit desértum in stagna aquárum: * et terram sine aqua in éxitus aquárum.
verses.eng: 106:35 He hath turned a wilderness into pools of water, * and a dry land into water springs.

verses.lat: 106:36 Et collocávit illic esuriéntes: * et constituérunt civitátem habitatiónis.
verses.eng: 106:36 And hath placed there the hungry; * and they made a city for their habitation.

verses.lat: 106:37 Et seminavérunt agros, et plantavérunt víneas: * et fecérunt fructum nativitátis.
verses.eng: 106:37 And they sowed fields, and planted vineyards: * and they yielded fruit of birth.

verses.lat: 106:38 Et benedíxit eis, et multiplicáti sunt nimis: * et juménta eórum non minorávit.
verses.eng: 106:38 And he blessed them, and they were multiplied exceedingly: * and their cattle he suffered not to decrease.

verses.lat: 106:39 Et pauci facti sunt: * et vexáti sunt a tribulatióne malórum, et dolóre.
verses.eng: 106:39 Then they were brought to be few: * and they were afflicted through the trouble of evils and sorrow.

verses.lat: 106:40 Effúsa est contémptio super príncipes: * et erráre fecit eos in ínvio, et non in via.
verses.eng: 106:40 Contempt was poured forth upon their princes: *and he caused them to wander where there was no passing, and out of the way.

verses.lat: 106:41 Et adjúvit páuperem de inópia: * et pósuit sicut oves famílias.
verses.eng: 106:41 And he helped the poor out of poverty: * and made him families like a flock of sheep.

verses.lat: 106:42 Vidébunt recti, et lætabúntur: * et omnis iníquitas oppilábit os suum.
verses.eng: 106:42 The just shall see, and shall rejoice, * and all iniquity shall stop their mouth.

verses.lat: 106:43 Quis sápiens et custódiet hæc? * et intélleget misericórdias Dómini.
verses.eng: 106:43 Who is wise, and will keep these things: * and will understand the mercies of the Lord?

matutinum.psalm10.antiphonLat: Vidébunt recti * et lætabúntur, et intéllegent misericórdias Dómini.
matutinum.psalm10.antiphonEng: The just see and rejoice * and understand the mercy of the Lord.

vesperae.psalm1.label: Psalmus 143(1-8)
vesperae.psalm1.antiphonLat: Benedíctus Dóminus * suscéptor meus et liberátor meus.
vesperae.psalm1.antiphonEng: Blessed be the Lord * my support, and my deliverer.

verses.lat: 143:1 Benedíctus Dóminus, Deus meus, qui docet manus meas ad prǽlium, * et dígitos meos ad bellum.
verses.eng: 143:1 Blessed be the Lord my God, who teacheth my hands to fight, * and my fingers to war.

verses.lat: 143:2 Misericórdia mea, et refúgium meum: * suscéptor meus, et liberátor meus:
verses.eng: 143:2 My mercy, and my refuge: * my support, and my deliverer:

verses.lat: 143:2 Protéctor meus, et in ipso sperávi: * qui subdit pópulum meum sub me.
verses.eng: 143:2 My protector, and I have hoped in him: * who subdueth my people under me.

verses.lat: 143:3 Dómine, quid est homo, quia innotuísti ei? * aut fílius hóminis, quia réputas eum?
verses.eng: 143:3 Lord, what is man, that thou art made known to him? * or the son of man, that thou makest account of him?

verses.lat: 143:4 Homo vanitáti símilis factus est: * dies ejus sicut umbra prætéreunt.
verses.eng: 143:4 Man is like to vanity: * his days pass away like a shadow.

verses.lat: 143:5 Dómine, inclína cælos tuos, et descénde: * tange montes, et fumigábunt.
verses.eng: 143:5 Lord, bow down thy heavens and descend: * touch the mountains, and they shall smoke.

verses.lat: 143:6 Fúlgura coruscatiónem, et dissipábis eos: * emítte sagíttas tuas, et conturbábis eos.
verses.eng: 143:6 Send forth lightning, and thou shalt scatter them: * shoot out thy arrows, and thou shalt trouble them.

verses.lat: 143:7 Emítte manum tuam de alto, éripe me, et líbera me de aquis multis: * de manu filiórum alienórum.
verses.eng: 143:7 Put forth thy hand from on high, take me out, and deliver me from many waters: * from the hand of strange children:

verses.lat: 143:8 Quorum os locútum est vanitátem: * et déxtera eórum, déxtera iniquitátis.
verses.eng: 143:8 Whose mouth hath spoken vanity: * and their right hand is the right hand of iniquity.

vesperae.psalm2.label: Psalmus 143(9-15)
vesperae.psalm2.antiphonLat: Beátus pópulus * cujus Dóminus Deus ejus.
vesperae.psalm2.antiphonEng: Happy is that people * whose God is the Lord.

verses.lat: 143:9 Deus, cánticum novum cantábo tibi: * in psaltério decachórdo psallam tibi.
verses.eng: 143:9 To thee, O God, I will sing a new canticle: * on the psaltery and an instrument of ten strings I will sing praises to thee.

verses.lat: 143:10 Qui das salútem régibus: * qui redemísti David, servum tuum, de gládio malígno: éripe me.
verses.eng: 143:10 Who givest salvation to kings: * who hast redeemed thy servant David from the malicious sword: Deliver me,

verses.lat: 143:11 Et érue me de manu filiórum alienórum, quorum os locútum est vanitátem: * et déxtera eórum, déxtera iniquitátis:
verses.eng: 143:11 And rescue me out of the hand of strange children; whose mouth hath spoken vanity: * and their right hand is the right hand of iniquity:

verses.lat: 143:12 Quorum fílii, sicut novéllæ plantatiónes * in juventúte sua.
verses.eng: 143:12 Whose sons are as new plants * in their youth:

verses.lat: 143:12 Fíliæ eórum compósitæ: * circumornátæ ut similitúdo templi.
verses.eng: 143:12 Their daughters decked out, * adorned round about after the similitude of a temple:

verses.lat: 143:13 Promptuária eórum plena, * eructántia ex hoc in illud.
verses.eng: 143:13 Their storehouses full, * flowing out of this into that.

verses.lat: 143:13 Oves eórum fœtósæ, abundántes in egréssibus suis: * boves eórum crassæ.
verses.eng: 143:13 Their sheep fruitful in young, abounding in their goings forth: * their oxen fat.

verses.lat: 143:14 Non est ruína macériæ, neque tránsitus: * neque clamor in platéis eórum.
verses.eng: 143:14 There is no breach of wall, nor passage, * nor crying out in their streets.

verses.lat: 143:15 Beátum dixérunt pópulum, cui hæc sunt: * beátus pópulus, cujus Dóminus Deus ejus.
verses.eng: 143:15 They have called the people happy, that hath these things: * but happy is that people whose God is the Lord.

vesperae.psalm3.label: Psalmus 144(1-7)
vesperae.psalm3.antiphonLat: Magnus Dóminus * et laudábilis nimis: et magnitúdinis ejus non est finis.
vesperae.psalm3.antiphonEng: For the Lord is great * and exceedingly to be praised: His greatness has no end.

verses.lat: 144:1 Exaltábo te, Deus meus, rex: * et benedícam nómini tuo in sǽculum, et in sǽculum sǽculi.
verses.eng: 144:1 I will extol thee, O God my king: * and I will bless thy name for ever; yea, for ever and ever.

verses.lat: 144:2 Per síngulos dies benedícam tibi: * et laudábo nomen tuum in sǽculum, et in sǽculum sǽculi.
verses.eng: 144:2 Every day will I bless thee: * and I will praise thy name for ever; yea, for ever and ever.

verses.lat: 144:3 Magnus Dóminus, et laudábilis nimis: * et magnitúdinis ejus non est finis.
verses.eng: 144:3 Great is the Lord, and greatly to be praised: * and of his greatness there is no end.

verses.lat: 144:4 Generátio et generátio laudábit ópera tua: * et poténtiam tuam pronuntiábunt.
verses.eng: 144:4 Generation and generation shall praise thy works: * and they shall declare thy power.

verses.lat: 144:5 Magnificéntiam glóriæ sanctitátis tuæ loquéntur: * et mirabília tua narrábunt.
verses.eng: 144:5 They shall speak of the magnificence of the glory of thy holiness: * and shall tell thy wondrous works.

verses.lat: 144:6 Et virtútem terribílium tuórum dicent: * et magnitúdinem tuam narrábunt.
verses.eng: 144:6 And they shall speak of the might of thy terrible acts: * and shall declare thy greatness.

verses.lat: 144:7 Memóriam abundántiæ suavitátis tuæ eructábunt: * et justítia tua exsultábunt.
verses.eng: 144:7 They shall publish the memory of the abundance of thy sweetness: * and shall rejoice in thy justice.

vesperae.psalm4.label: Psalmus 144(8-'13a')
vesperae.psalm4.antiphonLat: Suávis Dóminus * univérsis: et miseratiónes ejus super ómnia ópera ejus.
vesperae.psalm4.antiphonEng: The Lord is sweet * to all: and his tender mercies are over all his works.

verses.lat: 144:8 Miserátor, et miséricors Dóminus: * pátiens, et multum miséricors.
verses.eng: 144:8 The Lord is gracious and merciful: * patient and plenteous in mercy.

verses.lat: 144:9 Suávis Dóminus univérsis: * et miseratiónes ejus super ómnia ópera ejus.
verses.eng: 144:9 The Lord is sweet to all: * and his tender mercies are over all his works.

verses.lat: 144:10 Confiteántur tibi, Dómine, ómnia ópera tua: * et sancti tui benedícant tibi.
verses.eng: 144:10 Let all thy works, O Lord, praise thee: * and let thy saints bless thee.

verses.lat: 144:11 Glóriam regni tui dicent: * et poténtiam tuam loquéntur:
verses.eng: 144:11 They shall speak of the glory of thy kingdom: * and shall tell of thy power:

verses.lat: 144:12 Ut notam fáciant fíliis hóminum poténtiam tuam: * et glóriam magnificéntiæ regni tui.
verses.eng: 144:12 To make thy might known to the sons of men: * and the glory of the magnificence of thy kingdom.
